meta.title: Advanced Packaging Atlas
meta.basis_definition: Every extracted value carries basis (measured, design target, simulated, derived, author estimate, stated, unspecified) and source (text, table, figure, schematic, caption, mixed). Empty means not reported in the source; nothing is estimated.
meta.headline_definition: Headline numbers pick the most extreme matching row (minimum pitch, via diameter, minimum RDL line/space, minimum coupon loss; maximum bonding/process temperature, energy basis is minimum). The tooltip names the winning row's basis and locator.
